item.title: NOTICE OF AWARD TO STATEN ISLAND BAGEL CAFE, INC. TO PROVIDE FOR THE OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE CAFETERIA AT THE NEW YORK CITY POLICE DEPARTMENT POLICE ACADEMY
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $0 | Vendor: Staten Island Bagel Café, Inc.

The New York City Police Department has awarded a concession agreement to Staten Island Bagel Café, Inc. (Concessionaire), whose address is 3579 Victory Blvd, Staten Island, New York 10314, to provide for the operation and maintenance of the cafeteria at the New York City Police Departments Police Academy, located at 130-30 28th Avenue, College Point, New York 11354, in the borough of Queens. This concession contract was solicited through a Competitive Sealed Proposals method, pursuant to Section 1-13 of the Concession Rules of the City of New York. The concessionaire shall pay to the City a monthly concession fee of 6% of gross receipts. Gross receipts shall mean all revenue derived from the sale of food, beverages, merchandise, catering services, and vending operations. The term of the Concession is four (4) years, from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2030, with two (2) renewal options, each for a period of three (3) years.

item.title: Printing Press Equipment Maintenance and Repair
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-22

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD), to enter into sole source negotiations with Mark Andy, Inc, located at PO Box 300, 1 Riverside Avenue, Somerset, Massachusetts 02726.

NYPD has determined that Mark Andy Inc is the sole source vendor for Mark Andy Inc printing press equipment and maintenance services because Mark Andy Inc is the only authorized vendor that has necessary training certifications and authorized technicians to service the Presstek printing press equipments to make the necessary repairs, services and installations.

Any vendor besides Mark Andy Inc that believes that it can provide the services is invited to do so.  Complete specifications are found in Passport.  To respond in PASSPort, please upload a Capability Statement in the Documents Submission Section of the Manage Responses tab. If you have any questions about the details of the RFx, please submit them through the Discussion with Buyer tab and e-mail contracts@nypd.org.

item.title: Microspectrophotometer (MSP)
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $214K | Vendor: CRAIC Technologies Inc

The MSP is a mission-critical instrument used by the NYPD Forensic Investigations Unit to compare fibers transferred between a victim and a suspect. Craic Technologies is the sole manufacturer of an ultraviolet-visible-near infrared range microspectrophotometer that can meet key performance specifications vital to forensic operations.

item.title: FTIR Microspectrometer
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $220K | Vendor: Fisher Scientific Company, LLC

The brand-specific Thermo Fisher Fourier Transform Infrared Microspectrometer Instrument will be utilized in the Criminalistics Section of the Police Laboratory to identify and compare the organic components in paint, chemical unknowns, explosives, fibers, plastic bags and tape.

item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-02

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the New York City Police Department (NYPD) intends to enter into negotiations with Firstline Civil Construction LLC (Firstline) to provide comprehensive Maintenance and Repair Services of NYPDs Perimeter Security System located at 1 Police Plaza, New York, NY.

NYPD has determined that Firstline is the sole source vendor for these services because Firstline is the only authorized vendor that has necessary training certifications, authorized technicians, and access to the intellectual property to make the necessary repairs, services and installations on the Barrier One products located at 1 Police Plaza.  Due to the proprietary nature of the NYPDs Perimeter Security System, NYPD believes that only Firstline can legally provide the required services.
